title: Tiered changelog annotation and structured stakeholder review sprint
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a tiered, annotated changelog bundle and a formal signoff tracker so internal stakeholders can review and approve both internal and customer-facing changelogs. Focus on segmented audiences (self-serve, enterprise, partners), localization readiness, and redaction guidance for sensitive customers.
tasks: Draft primary user-facing changelog entries for self-serve and enterprise segments
Create an 'annotation' column describing customer impact, upgrade guidance, and migration notes
Assemble signoff tracker with owners for product, engineering, design, legal, and support
Run a 48-hour internal review window with targeted reviewers per segment
Prepare redaction checklist and embargoed asset handling for privacy-sensitive features
Export localized strings for Spanish and German teams; confirm translation deadlines
Publish final customer changelog and internal brief; sync with GTM calendar
